chunks.content: ## Onion Quilting Stitching Technique in CLO: Overview This section explains the step-by-step process of creating an onion line pattern in CLO, focusing on drawing precise shapes using ruler tools, line adjustments, angle settings, and mirror functions. Key terms include onion line, inner line, vertical Y-axis, angle adjustment, mirror copy, and curve editing. --- ## Drawing the Base Onion Line and Inner Lines Begin by drawing a rectangle using a ruler tool in CLO. The length and width are customizable based on your design needs. - Draw an inner line centered within the rectangle, setting its length to exactly 15 cm via the length input dialog. - Double-click to finish the line. - Create small lines on top of the inner line shaped like triangles. - Optionally, draw a slightly larger rectangle around the inner line. - Divide the inner line into two equal segments for further detailing. --- ## Creating Small Lines and Setting Angles To add detailed stitching lines: - Draw two small lines on top of the inner line, each set to 5 mm in length. - Use the "left and right" alignment options after selecting all lines to symmetrically position them. - Delete any unwanted baseline that appears after generation. - Generate vertical lines at the same points: - Set the vertical line angle to 45 degrees relative to the Y-axis and apply left-right mirroring. - Repeat for 90 degrees to align perfectly vertical to the Y-axis. - Delete unwanted baselines after each step to keep the workspace clean. --- ## Adjusting the Onion Shape Using Curve Tools The shape of the onion line is refined by adjusting curves: - Avoid unwanted curve distortions caused by mouse drag (meniscus effect) by pressing Esc to cancel and clicking directly to place points. - Use the "click curve point" tool to modify curve shape precisely. - Add or remove curve points to fine-tune the shape. - To replicate a pattern exactly, place the mouse pointer on the desired curve and use the curve adjustment tools to resize or modify without distortion. - If needed, right-click and rewrite to delete unwanted curves. --- ## Mirroring and Copying Lines for Symmetry CLO allows efficient duplication and mirroring of line segments: - Select a line or group of lines, right-click, and use the "copy as mirror" or "copy as mirror inner line" options. - Choose the mirror base line for accurate reflection. - Repeat mirroring for multiple lines to build symmetrical onion shapes. - Delete unnecessary lines before framing the shape. - Merge broken points by selecting empty points, right-clicking, and choosing "merge refraction points." - Convert merged points to free line points for more flexible editing. --- ## Using Clipboard Commands and Keyboard Shortcuts Efficient editing utilizes copy-paste and keyboard shortcuts: - Use right-click copy and paste commands to duplicate selected lines. - Holding the Shift key while pasting can delete the pasted content. - Use Ctrl + C and Ctrl + V for standard copy-paste operations.
